# PC Gamer

> PC Gamer is the leading source for PC gaming news, reviews, hardware coverage, and community discussion, covering everything from AAA titles to indie games and gaming peripherals.

PC Gamer provides comprehensive coverage of the PC gaming industry through news articles, in-depth reviews, buying guides, and a vibrant community forum. The publication is owned by Future and delivers content across multiple platforms including web, print magazine, and community forums.

## Key Topics

- PC Gaming
- Game Reviews
- Steam Platform
- Gaming Hardware
- Graphics Cards
- Action Games
- RPG Games
- Roguelike Games
- Gaming News
- Gaming Peripherals
- Processors
- Simulation Games
- Game Development
- DLSS Technology
- Community Discussion

## Games & Reviews

- [Games Coverage](https://www.pcgamer.com/games): PC Gamer's games coverage hub with news, reviews, and features on latest titles.
- [Game Reviews](https://www.pcgamer.com/games/reviews): Game reviews covering action, RPG, strategy, and other PC gaming genres.
- [Gaming News](https://www.pcgamer.com/news): Latest PC gaming news, game releases, and industry updates from PC Gamer.

## Hardware & Components

- [Hardware Coverage](https://www.pcgamer.com/hardware): PC Gamer's hardware coverage including peripherals, graphics cards, and components.

## Guides & Resources

- [PC Gaming Guides](https://www.pcgamer.com/guides): PC gaming guides, tips, buying guides for hardware and gaming laptops.
- [Software Coverage](https://www.pcgamer.com/software): Software coverage including Steam, AI gaming, DLSS, and game development news.

## Magazine & Media

- [PC Gamer Print Magazine](https://www.pcgamer.com/pc-gamer-print-magazine): PC Gamer print magazine with reviews, interviews, and Top 100 game rankings.
- [Movies & TV Coverage](https://www.pcgamer.com/movies-tv): Game adaptations, film announcements, and entertainment news related to gaming.

## Community & Support

- [PC Gamer Forums](https://forums.pcgamer.com): PC Gamer community forums for gaming discussion and user-generated content.
- [Commenting Rules and Guidelines](https://www.pcgamer.com/commenting-rules-and-guidelines): Community guidelines and moderation rules for PC Gamer comments.

## About PC Gamer

- [About PC Gamer](https://www.pcgamer.com/about-pc-gamer): About PC Gamer: company information, subscriptions, and editorial policies.
- [Meet the Team](https://www.pcgamer.com/meet-the-team): PC Gamer staff profiles and team information from Future publishing.

## Optional

- [A Note on Affiliate Links](https://www.pcgamer.com/a-note-on-affiliate-links): Disclosure on affiliate links and monetization supporting independent testing.
